description: This file defines a utility class 'Assert' providing static methods for runtime argument validation, such as null checks, type assertions, and emptiness checks. It is used to enforce method argument constraints and throw IllegalArgumentException if conditions are not met.

classes.name: Assert
classes.description: A utility class containing static methods to assert conditions on method arguments, such as type checks, null checks, and non-emptiness checks, throwing IllegalArgumentException when validations fail.

methods.name: isAssignableTo
methods.description: Checks if an argument is not null and can be assigned to the specified class. Throws IllegalArgumentException if validation fails.

methods.name: isInstanceOf
methods.description: Checks if an argument is not null and is an instance of the specified class. Throws exception if not.

methods.name: isInstanceOf (overloaded)
methods.description: Checks if an argument is an instance of any of the provided classes.

methods.name: isNotInstanceOf
methods.description: Checks that an argument is not an instance of the specified class.

methods.name: isNotInstanceOf (overloaded)
methods.description: Checks that an argument is not an instance of any of the specified classes.

methods.name: notEmpty (String)
methods.description: Verifies that a String argument is not null and not empty.

methods.name: notEmpty (Map)
methods.description: Verifies that a Map argument is not null and not empty.

methods.name: notEmpty (Collection)
methods.description: Verifies that a Collection argument is not null and not empty.

methods.name: notEmpty (array)
methods.description: Verifies that an array argument is not null and has length greater than zero.

methods.name: notNull (Object...)
methods.description: Checks multiple arguments for null; expects arguments as pairs of (argumentName, argumentObject).

methods.name: notNull
methods.description: Checks that a single argument is not null.
